result.instructions: Tools for Agiloft, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which Agiloft tables hold contract records?"; "Search the contracts table for records that are still open."; "Show me the full record with id 358 from the contacts table.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Agiloft data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run agiloft_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run agiloft_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run agiloft_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. agiloft_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: agiloft_list_tables
tools.title: List tables
tools.description: List the tables of the Agiloft knowledgebase (label and logical name). Pass table and include_fields=true to get that table's fields. Use the logical names in the other tools. Agiloft REST: EWTable.

include_fields.description: true = also return the fields of the table (needs table).

tools.name: agiloft_get_record
tools.title: Get a record
tools.description: Get one record by id, with all its fields as the KB user can see them. Use agiloft_list_tables to find the table and its fields. Agiloft REST: EWRead.

table.description: Table logical name, case sensitive (for example case or contacts.employees).

tools.name: agiloft_search_records
tools.title: Search records
tools.description: Search a table with an ad hoc query (for example summary~='test'&&priority=3; ~= means contains) and return the number of matches and the requested fields. Pages with page and limit. Agiloft REST: EWSearch.

table.description: Table logical name, case sensitive (for example case or contacts.employees).

query.description: Ad hoc query in Agiloft syntax, for example status='Open'. Leave empty for all records.

fields.description: Logical field names to return with each record.
